connection.description: Named connection from the operator's analytics connection registry (e.g. 'warehouse-readonly', 'sqlite-local'). Direct DSNs are not accepted — the connection name resolves to a vetted DSN + role at lease time.

sql.description: SQL statement. Runner parses the AST; anything but SELECT / WITH ... SELECT / EXPLAIN is rejected unless the lease explicitly opts into writes (which trips human approval).

parameters.description: Named bind parameters. Inlining literal strings into the SQL is allowed but discouraged — parameters are how the runner enforces injection-safety.

max_rows.description: Hard cap on rows returned. Runner appends/clamps LIMIT and sets 'truncated: true' if hit.

max_seconds.description: Query wall-clock budget. Runner cancels on the underlying engine when supported.

output_format.description: Shape of the returned rows. 'rows' = array of objects; 'columnar' = arrays per column (cheaper for wide narrow result sets).

type.description: Engine-reported type label (e.g. 'INTEGER', 'TEXT', 'TIMESTAMP'); not normalized across engines.

rows.description: Present when output_format='rows'. Each element is an object keyed by column name.

columns_data.description: Present when output_format='columnar'. Aligned with 'columns' by index.

truncated.description: True when max_rows was hit before the result set was exhausted.

summary: Run a SELECT/EXPLAIN against a registered analytics connection with parameter binding, row cap, and wall-clock timeout. Writes are off by default and trip human approval when enabled.
notes: Cost/latency estimates are coarse — actual cost depends on the resolved DSN. For warehouse engines that bill per byte scanned, prefer EXPLAIN first to confirm the planner accepts the query shape.
